% FlashTeX math visual corpus fixture (crates/math-layout, FT-020 rev 3).
% The preamble is the structural oracle's: 12pt article with the real Computer
% Modern fonts (OT1 cmr12/cmmi12/cmsy10/cmex10 — the metrics this crate
% embeds), geometry margin=1in, uncompressed streams so tools/structural_gate.py
% can read glyph and rule origins. tests/visual-corpus/harness replaces
% everything before \begin{document} with its own engine preambles (times/lm
% variants, whose text and Latin Modern fonts differ from CM in some glyph
% heights and italic corrections). Only the body is the declared fixture
% content; the corpus compiler (flashtex-math-corpus) recognises it verbatim.
\pdfcompresslevel=0
\pdfobjcompresslevel=0
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\noindent$\displaystyle\left\{\frac{\frac{\frac{a}{b}}{c}}{\frac{d}{\frac{e}{f}}}\right\}$
\end{document}
